cohort: The study included data from 1,024 preimplantation genetic testing-frozen embryo transfer cycles performed at a tertiary academic medical center between March 2016 and December 2021.
finding: The absence of the zona pellucida did not independently affect clinical, obstetric, or perinatal outcomes in vitrified-warmed single euploid blastocyst transfers after adjusting for confounders.
mod_finding: The absence of zona pellucida was not significantly associated with cesarean delivery after propensity score matching, although maternal age and endometrial thickness were identified as significant predictors for cesarean delivery.
